text: Route: /book-appointment (permission: public.book, Livewire component: App\Livewire\Public\AppointmentBooking, layout: layouts.guest). This is the ONLY page in the entire application accessible without login. Patients self-book appointments without creating an account. The booking flow is a 4-step cascading wizard.
The AppointmentBooking component resolves the tenant for public bookings via publicTenantId():

items: First checks config('appointment.public_tenant_id') - if set in config/appointment.php, uses that tenant ID explicitly.
If not configured, falls back to the first hospital in the database: Hospital::withoutGlobalScopes()->orderBy('id')->value('id').
If no hospital exists, defaults to tenant ID 1.
All queries in the booking flow use withoutGlobalScopes() and explicitly filter by this tenant_id AND history=1.

rows: Duration of each appointment slot in minutes. Controls the time increment for available slots.
Start of working hours. Slots are generated from this time onward.
End of working hours. No slots are generated after this time.
Explicit tenant ID for public bookings. If null, auto-resolves to first hospital or 1.

items: department_id (string|null) - Selected department ID.
health_care_professional_id (string|null) - Selected doctor/HC Professional ID.
appointment_date (string|null) - Selected date (Y-m-d format).
patient_name (string) - Patient's full name. Required, max 150 chars.
patient_phone (string|null) - Patient's phone. Optional, max 30 chars.
patient_email (string|null) - Patient's email. Optional, email format, max 150 chars.
reason (string|null) - Reason for visit. Optional, max 5000 chars.
selected_slot (string|null) - The chosen time slot (H:i format, e.g. '09:00').
booked (bool) - Whether booking was successful.
booked_code (string|null) - The generated appointment code (APT-XXXXX) on success.
booked_slots (array) - Available slots loaded for the selected doctor+date.
department_id: required, integer
health_care_professional_id: required, integer
appointment_date: required, date, after_or_equal:today (cannot book in the past)
patient_name: required, string, max:150
patient_phone: nullable, string, max:30
patient_email: nullable, email, max:150
reason: nullable, string, max:5000

text: The departments list (getDepartmentsProperty) loads active departments for the public tenant:

items: Query: Department::withoutGlobalScopes()->where('tenant_id', $tid)->where('is_active', 1)->where('history', 1)->orderBy('dept_name')->get(['id', 'dept_name', 'dept_code'])
Each option shows dept_name with dept_code in parentheses.

When department_id changes (updatedDepartmentId): resets health_care_professional_id, appointment_date, selected_slot, and booked_slots to null. This is the cascade reset - selecting a new department clears all downstream selections.

text: The doctors list (getDoctorsProperty) loads HCPs for the selected department:

items: Returns empty collection if no department_id is selected.

Query: HealthCareProfessional::withoutGlobalScopes()->where('tenant_id', $tid)->where('department_id', $this->department_id)->where('is_active', 1)->where('history', 1)->orderBy('full_name')->get(['id', 'full_name', 'professional_type', 'specialization'])
Each option shows full_name with professional_type and specialization as subtitle.

When health_care_professional_id changes (updatedHealthCareProfessionalId): resets appointment_date, selected_slot, and booked_slots. Clears the date and slots so the user picks a fresh date for the new doctor.

text: Patient picks an appointment date using a date picker. The date must be today or later (validated by after_or_equal:today). When appointment_date changes (updatedAppointmentDate): resets selected_slot and calls loadAvailableSlots() to fetch the available time slots for the selected doctor on the selected date.
loadAvailableSlots() computes available slots as follows:

items: Returns empty array if no health_care_professional_id or no appointment_date.
Parses the appointment_date to a date string.
Gets slot_minutes from config (default 30), working_start (default 08:00), working_end (default 17:00).

Queries existing appointments: DoctorAppointment::withoutGlobalScopes()->where('tenant_id', $tid)->where('health_care_professional_id', $this->health_care_professional_id)->where('appointment_date', $date)->where('status', '!=', 'Cancelled')->get(['start_time', 'end_time'])
Maps existing appointments to ['start' => start_time, 'end' => end_time] pairs.
Generates slots from working_start to working_end in slot_minutes increments. For each slot: formats start (H:i) and end (H:i), creates a label like '9:00 AM'.
Overlap check for each slot: $taken->contains(fn ($b) => $st < $b['end'] && $et > $b['start']). If the slot overlaps with any existing appointment, it is excluded.
Past slot check: if the appointment_date is today AND the slot start is before now(), the slot is excluded (cannot book a slot that has already passed today).
All non-overlapping, non-past slots are added to booked_slots with keys: start, end, label.
The UI renders booked_slots as selectable buttons. When patient clicks a slot, selectSlot($slot) sets selected_slot to the H:i string.

text: After selecting a slot, the patient fills in:

items: patient_name (required) - The patient's full name. Max 150 characters.
patient_phone (optional) - Contact phone number. Max 30 characters.
patient_email (optional) - Email address for confirmation. Must be valid email format, max 150 characters.
reason (optional) - Reason for the visit / chief complaint. Max 5000 characters.

text: The book() method is the core booking logic. It runs inside a database transaction for atomicity:

items: Validates all form fields using the rules above.
If no selected_slot, adds error 'Please choose an available time slot.' and returns.
Parses the slot: $slotStart = Carbon::parse($date . ' ' . $this->selected_slot), $slotEnd = $slotStart->copy()->addMinutes($slotMinutes). Formats start_time and end_time as H:i.
GENERATES APPOINTMENT CODE via generateCode($tid):
- Queries the last appointment for this tenant: DoctorAppointment::withoutGlobalScopes()->where('tenant_id', $tid)->orderBy('id', 'desc')->first()
- Parses the numeric portion after 'APT-': (int) substr($last->appointment_code, 4)
- Increments by 1: $num = $last ? ((int) substr($last->appointment_code, 4)) + 1 : 1
- Formats: 'APT-' . str_pad($num, 5, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT) — e.g. APT-00001, APT-00002, etc.
ATOMIC TRANSACTION (DB::transaction):

- DOUBLE-BOOKING CHECK inside the transaction: Queries for conflicts with lockForUpdate(): DoctorAppointment::withoutGlobalScopes()->where('tenant_id', $tid)->where('health_care_professional_id', $this->health_care_professional_id)->where('appointment_date', $date)->where('status', '!=', 'Cancelled')->where('start_time', '<', $et)->where('end_time', '>', $st)->lockForUpdate()->exists()

- The lockForUpdate() is critical: it locks the rows so no other request can insert a conflicting appointment between the check and the insert. This prevents race conditions where two patients book the same slot simultaneously.

- If conflict found: adds error 'Sorry, this slot was just taken. Please pick another time.', calls loadAvailableSlots() to refresh the slot list, and returns (throws exception to rollback transaction).
- If no conflict: creates the appointment with all fields.
APPOINTMENT RECORD CREATED:
- tenant_id: public tenant ID
- appointment_code: generated APT-XXXXX code
- department_id: selected department
- health_care_professional_id: selected doctor
- appointment_date: selected date (Y-m-d)
- start_time: slot start (H:i)
- end_time: slot end (H:i)
- patient_name: from form
- patient_phone: from form (nullable)
- patient_email: from form (nullable)
- reason: from form (nullable)
- status: 'Scheduled'
- is_active: true
- history: 1
- created_by: null (public booking has no authenticated user)
- created_date: now()
- updated_by: null
- updated_date: null
On success: sets booked = true, booked_code = generated code. The UI shows the confirmation screen with all appointment details and the APT-XXXXX reference code.
If the transaction fails (e.g. conflict), the transaction is rolled back automatically by Laravel.

text: After successful booking, the confirmation screen shows:

items: Appointment Code: APT-XXXXX (the reference number the patient should keep)
Department name
Doctor name (full_name)
Date: formatted appointment date
Time: formatted start_time - end_time (e.g. '9:00 AM - 9:30 AM')
Patient name
Patient phone (if provided)
Patient email (if provided)
Reason (if provided)
Status: Scheduled

text: The Book Another Appointment button (bookAnother method) resets ALL form fields: department_id, health_care_professional_id, appointment_date, patient_name, patient_phone, patient_email, reason, selected_slot, booked_code, booked. Also calls resetValidation() to clear any validation errors. The form is ready for a new booking.

items: Scheduled - Initial status when booked via public booking. The appointment is on the doctor's schedule but has not been seen yet.
In Progress - Doctor has started the consultation. Set via Doctors > Schedule > Mark In Progress.
Completed - Consultation finished. Set via Doctors > Schedule > Mark Done.
Cancelled - Appointment cancelled before occurrence. Set via Doctors > Schedule > Cancel. Cancelled appointments are excluded from slot availability checks (where('status', '!=', 'Cancelled')).
